text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot is an arm's mean score over 31 series (solar, wind, demand, battery, and biofuel) and 53 weekly ECMWF ensemble (ENS) forecast runs, scored from July 2025 to June 2026; average of seeds 0, 1, 2. Each score is a share of the series' own effective capacity. Each line is the 95% interval from resampling whole months. Month-to-month swings are shared by all arms, so overlapping intervals can hide a real gap (see Figure 2). Every arm is trained on one XGBoost model per series from the same weather; arms differ only in the one change in the label. Round 2 labels list the ideas combined: abs. loss is the absolute-error loss, stop is early stopping, lead is the forecast lead-time column, wind is the lean wind-farm columns, and pooled is one model per series type with a site identifier.'
